pub type Raw
pub enum Profile
  Video
  ImageBatch
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub enum Mode
  Generate
  Edit
  pub const ALL: [Self; 2]
  pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str
  pub fn from_wire(name: &str) -> Option<Self>
pub mod request_guarantee
  pub const LOCAL_ONLY: &str
  pub const HOSTED_ALLOWED: &str
  pub const ALL: [&str; 2]
pub const KINDS: [&str; 1]
pub const EXECUTION_GUARANTEES: [&str; 1]
pub struct ImageRequest
  model: String
  mode: Mode
  prompt: String
  size: String
  count: i64
  image_digest: String
  image_media_type: String
  mask_digest: String
  mask_media_type: String
  guarantees: Vec<String>
  credential: String
  required_extensions: Vec<String>
  extensions: BTreeMap<String, String>
pub struct Delivery
  digest: String
  media_type: String
  size: i64
  location: String
pub struct Request
  profile: Profile
  image: ImageRequest
  duration_ms: i64
pub struct JobResult
  profile: Profile
  deliveries: Vec<Delivery>
  host: String
  model: String
pub struct Document
  request: Option<Request>
  result: Option<JobResult>
pub fn encode(v: &Document) -> Vec<u8>
pub struct Refusal
  word: &'static str
  offset: usize
pub fn decode(data: &[u8]) -> Result<Document, Refusal>
